page.overview:
Who is Dee-Jay?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Dee-Jay was the only Battle Force 2000 character introduced in the 1989 series of A Real American Hero toys. ----

Appearance: white helmet with silver goggles and red bar on forehead; olive green shirt with white armor vest and gloves; blue pants with silver codpiece, white boots, and dark grey leggings and holster
